name: Kenji Tanaka
household: Wife, Akiko; grown son moved out last year
psychographics: Prioritizes efficiency and precision in the kitchen; views cooking as a data-driven hobby rather than a chore
current_solutions: Relies heavily on the Cookpad app for quick recipe searches, and owns a Sharp superheated steam oven. He uses a local supermarket's app to reserve his weekly fresh fish delivery, syncing it with his calendar.
frustration: Yesterday at 10:30 AM, his internet connection dropped for exactly 22 minutes right as he was trying to sync his steam oven's recipe database; the oven locked him out and displayed an error code E-07, requiring a manual reboot he couldn't figure out from the manual.
decision_style: He reads tech blogs and watches YouTube unboxing videos religiously before purchasing any kitchen gadget, comparing specs obsessively, but often suffers from 'analysis paralysis' and delays the purchase.
voice: Rambling and technical. He frequently uses Japanese loanwords (e.g., 'umami', 'sear') and English tech jargon ('latency', 'API') in the same breath, often trailing off mid-sentence when demonstrating a feature.
